claims.head: Daccord gets another crack at the Wild
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Daccord has been shaky against the Wild, well below his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if he’s back to his usual self.
claims.nums: 6 starts against Minnesota: .858 save percentage · .907 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Daccord’s record against the Wild.
claims.call: If Daccord starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .907 than to his .858 against the Wild.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 6 against Minnesota, 4,201 shots against everyone else

chips.tip: Daccord: .858 save percentage in 6 starts against Minnesota since 2023-24.
Daccord: .907 save percentage against everyone else since 2023-24, on 4,201 shots.

claims.head: The Wild should tilt the ice
claims.body: The Wild have been near the top of the league at controlling the chances at 5-on-5, and the Kraken near the bottom. Expect the Wild to spend more of the night in the Kraken’s end. That’s about the puck, not the scoreboard: goalies and finishing decide plenty of games the chances don’t.
claims.call: The Wild get the bigger share of the 5-on-5 chances.
claims.nums: Share of 5-on-5 expected goals: Minnesota 52.4%, Seattle 46.2%
claims.gist: The Wild usually control more of the chances than the Kraken do.

claims.body: The Wild play some of the league’s fastest games, and so do the Kraken. We think this one runs hotter than either team’s usual.

notes.text: Vince Dunn has started killing penalties: on the ice for 43% of the team’s shorthanded time in 11 games, up from 2% last season.

stakes: The Wild go in tied for first in the Central with 14 points, the Kraken third in the Pacific with 15 points.

SEA.head: Not an easy night for the Kraken
SEA.body: Even though Seattle has home-ice advantage, Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Kraken’s best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.

MIN.head: Advantage, the Wild
MIN.body: Even though Seattle has home-ice advantage, Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Kraken can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

paras: The Kraken have won two in a row. The Wild are 6-3-2.

items.text: Quinn Hughes is two points from 500.
The Wild have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start.
Matt Boldy has a point in nine straight games against Seattle.
The Kraken are newly without Jared McCann.
